name: omp-subagent-guard
description: An oh-my-pi (omp) extension that keeps your limits on the work an agent delegates: it gates every task spawn (named owner, allowed and pinned agent definitions, spawn cap, isolation reachability), re-checks every subagent tool call (tool allowlist, protected paths, per-agent write scope with a prompt forwarded to the owner), and writes an audit log that links each spawn to what its subagent did.
